title: Rovo: Centralized overview for admins
description:
Atlassian Administration now includes a centralized overview page for Rovo. This new landing experience helps organization admins discover key capabilities, take recommended actions, and explore AI-powered experiences in one place. By providing a clear entry point, the overview page makes it easier to understand Rovo and drive adoption across your organization. Log in to Atlassian Administration at admin.atlassian.com.
